text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I spotted
Meisho Doto letting out a deep sigh.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah~~~~~. Why am I
always so utterly useless...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, T-Trainer...
It's nothing, just my skin acting up a bit...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "It must be because I accidentally poured sesame oil over my greens instead of soy sauce yesterday..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And then my hand slipped...
At that point, it wasn't dressed greens anymore, it was sesame oil soup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she probably couldn't bring herself to leave any behind.
Meisho Doto was thoroughly dejected over
both her clumsiness and her skin breaking out.
